description: Deterministic validation checklists, Microsoft Graph / SharePoint / Dataverse OAuth scopes, redirect URIs, and automated probes for Microsoft 365 and Entra ID connectors in Gemini Enterprise.

sections.title: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) App Registration & Credentials
sections.description: Ensure you have a single-tenant Microsoft Entra ID registered application ('Accounts in this organizational directory only'), valid OAuth credentials, and exact Web redirect URIs.

items.label: Tenant ID (tenant_id)
items.subLabel: Your Microsoft 365 Directory (tenant) ID from the Microsoft Entra Admin Center Overview page.

items.label: Application (Client) ID (client_id)
items.subLabel: Application (client) ID from Entra App Registration configured for 'Accounts in this organizational directory only' (Single tenant).

items.label: Client Secret (client_secret)
items.subLabel: Unexpired client secret Value copied from Certificates & secrets > Client secrets.

items.label: SharePoint Instance URI
items.subLabel: Format: https://<DOMAIN>.sharepoint.com for all first-level sites or https://<DOMAIN>.sharepoint.com/sites/<WEBSITE> for a single site.

items.label: Data Store Redirect URI (Platform: Web)
items.subLabel: Add this exact Web redirect URI in the Authentication section of your App Registration for data store setup.

items.label: Federated & Actions OAuth Redirect URI (Platform: Web)
items.subLabel: Add this exact Web redirect URI in the Authentication section for Federated Search and Assistant Actions.

items.label: Federated Credential for Data Ingestion (Optional)
items.subLabel: If using Federated credentials in Data Ingestion mode, add an 'Other issuer' credential with Issuer https://accounts.google.com and the Subject identifier from Google Cloud Console.

items.label: Tenant-Wide Admin Consent Granted
items.subLabel: Microsoft Entra Global Administrator must click 'Grant admin consent for [Organization]' (and 'Consent on behalf of your organization' on first login) to prevent 'Need admin approval' blocks.

items.label: Discovery Engine Service Agent IAM Role
items.subLabel: Verifies Discovery Engine service agent permissions on the host Google Cloud project.

automatedProbe.description: Checks Discovery Engine service agent IAM bindings on the project.

items.label: Connector Endpoint & Auth State Check
items.subLabel: Verifies non-redacted instance/tenant parameters, actionConfig state, and absence of 401/OAuth errors in GCP (note: client_id, client_secret, and vendor portal scopes are redacted by GCP on read and must be attested manually above).

automatedProbe.description: Verifies non-redacted connector endpoint/tenant parameters and checks for backend OAuth/auth errors in Discovery Engine.

items.label: Connector State & Sync Health
items.subLabel: Discovery Engine connector status is ACTIVE with no failing crawl operations.

automatedProbe.description: Validates SharePoint connector operational state and sync logs.

sections.title: Microsoft Graph & SharePoint Read Scopes
sections.description: Configure API permissions in Microsoft Graph and Microsoft SharePoint based on whether you use Data Ingestion or Federated Search.

items.label: GroupMember.Read.All (Microsoft Graph - Application)
items.subLabel: Allows the connector to read memberships and basic group properties for all groups without a signed-in user for ACL security trimming.

items.label: User.Read.All or User.ReadBasic.All (Microsoft Graph - Application)
items.subLabel: Allows the connector to read user profiles across the organization for identity mapping.

items.label: User.Read (Microsoft Graph - Delegated)
items.subLabel: Allows reading the profile and basic company information of signed-in users.

items.label: Sites.FullControl.All or Sites.Selected (Microsoft Graph - Application)
items.subLabel: Select one Site Control option in Microsoft Graph: Sites.FullControl.All (all site collections) or Sites.Selected (specific site subset).

items.label: Sites.FullControl.All or Sites.Selected (SharePoint API - Application)
items.subLabel: Required when using Federated Credentials for Data Ingestion: grant Sites.FullControl.All or Sites.Selected under Microsoft SharePoint Application permissions.

items.label: AllSites.FullControl, AllSites.Read, Sites.Search.All, or Sites.Selected (SharePoint API - Delegated)
items.subLabel: Required when using OAuth 2.0 refresh token for Data Ingestion: grant AllSites.FullControl (or AllSites.Read / Sites.Search.All / Sites.Selected) under Microsoft SharePoint Delegated permissions.

items.label: Grant fullcontrol to Selected Sites (When Using Sites.Selected)
items.subLabel: Warning: When using Sites.Selected, you must explicitly grant 'fullControl' via PnP PowerShell (Grant-PnPAzureADAppSitePermission) or Graph API POST /sites/{siteId}/permissions, and specify a single site instance URL or precise siteName filters.

items.label: Sites.Search.All (SharePoint API - Delegated)
items.subLabel: Allows running search queries and reading basic site info on behalf of the signed-in user. Note: No Microsoft Graph API permissions are required for basic Federated Search.

items.label: AllSites.Read or Sites.Selected (SharePoint API - Delegated)
items.subLabel: Select one Site Access option in Microsoft SharePoint Delegated permissions: AllSites.Read (all site collections) or Sites.Selected (specific site collections).

items.label: Admin Consent Granted for Federated Delegated Scopes
items.subLabel: Entra ID Global Administrator has granted tenant-wide admin consent for Sites.Search.All and AllSites.Read / Sites.Selected.

sections.title: Assistant Actions & Write Scopes
sections.description: Delegated Microsoft Graph and SharePoint permissions required for creating, updating, uploading, or deleting content in SharePoint via Gemini Assistant.

items.label: Actions Redirect URI Allowlisted
items.subLabel: Actions always use https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/oauth-redirect in Entra App Registration Authentication.

items.label: Files.ReadWrite.All & Files.ReadWrite (Microsoft Graph - Delegated)
items.subLabel: Allows the connector to read (download), create (upload), update, and delete the signed-in user's files and all files the user can access.

items.label: Sites.ReadWrite.All (Microsoft Graph - Delegated)
items.subLabel: Allows the connector to edit or delete documents and list items in all site collections on behalf of the signed-in user.

items.label: Sites.Manage.All (Microsoft Graph - Delegated)
items.subLabel: Allows the connector to create or delete document libraries and lists in all site collections on behalf of the user.

items.label: AllSites.Write (SharePoint API - Delegated)
items.subLabel: Allows the connector to create, read, update, delete, upload, and download documents and list items in all site collections on behalf of the signed-in user.

items.label: Admin Consent for Write Permissions
items.subLabel: Global Administrator must grant tenant-wide consent for Files.ReadWrite.All, Sites.ReadWrite.All, Sites.Manage.All, and AllSites.Write.

items.label: Contacts.Read (Delegated)
